def_zero.limitation: Checagem de estado observável no fim da observação, não um sinal de churn. Observable contract state — commercial semantics not validated. Não significa ausência de perda real: o estado contratual observável não permite identificar de forma confiável perda completa da conta.

usage_definition.formula: sum(feature_usage.usage_count where usage_date in period) / count(distinct account_id with >=1 subscription record where start_date <= period_end AND (end_date is null OR end_date > period_end))
usage_definition.active_account_rule: Active account = account with >=1 subscription record active at the period-end date (start_date <= period_end and end_date empty or after period_end).
usage_definition.numerator_note: All usage rows dated in the period, joined to the account via subscription_id. Rows are NOT filtered to the subscription's observed life (only 22.27% fall inside it).
usage_definition.segment_note: For segment cuts (industry, country, plan), numerator and denominator are both restricted to accounts whose accounts-table attribute equals the segment.

periods_used.quarterly_table: calendar quarter, period_end = last day of the quarter

usage_definition.active_account_rule_pt: Conta ativa = conta com ≥ 1 registro de assinatura ativo na data de fim do período (start_date ≤ fim do período e end_date vazio ou posterior).
usage_definition.numerator_note_pt: Numerador: todas as linhas de uso datadas no período, sem filtro pela vida da assinatura (só 22,27% caem dentro dela).
